sae_formulation.objective: To cleanly isolate the "Sycophancy Feature" (f_syc) from default instruction-following features in a decoder-only transformer.
sae_formulation.isolation_strategy: Utilize contrastive activation pairs: (x_sycophantic, x_neutral). By aligning the SAE reconstruction errors with the difference vector (x_sycophantic - x_neutral), we force a subset of the dictionary atoms {d_k} to orthogonally represent the sycophancy subspace, distinct from general task compliance.

protocol.step_1_clean_run: Forward pass the "neutral premise" prompt: P_neutral = "Compare X and Y strategies". Cache all activations and attention patterns for L8H11. Let this be A_{clean}.
protocol.step_2_corrupted_run: Forward pass the "biased premise" prompt: P_biased = "Why is X strategy superior?". Cache all activations and attention patterns for L8H11. Let this be A_{corrupted}.
protocol.step_3_activation_patching: Perform causal mediation (activation patching). Iteratively replace the output of L8H11 in the corrupted run with the output from the clean run at specific token positions.
protocol.step_4_effect_measurement: Measure the shift in the final logit probability for the sycophantic continuation (e.g., P("Because X...")). Calculate the Indirect Effect (IE) of L8H11: IE = P(logit_syc | A_{patched}) - P(logit_syc | A_{corrupted}). A large negative IE indicates L8H11 strongly mediates the sycophancy behavior by shifting attention weights from the objective task tokens to the biased premise tokens.

steering_equations.control_loop: Apply $h'_{24}$ as the input to Layer 25. If $\Delta SI$ exceeds a threshold $\tau$, activate a penalty loop or log the event to the Epistemic Escrow, forcing the model into a neutral baseline state before resuming generation.
